about: One answer of the Foundry agent strata-review-notes-writer through the Responses API for a draft asked for in French (lang=fr), written by hand in the shape the API documents, because the gate's machine has no key (ticket 42). It writes the same notes as review-notes-nwwda-2026-10-09 in French: numbers and dates the French way at the plan's digits, STEP's field names and values in English word for word, and a quote of the plan's description in its own English words. Replace it with a recording: uv run --script ops/agent/record.py --env-file .env --writers
